contribution.description: score times coefficient, in the units of predicted_slope
contribution.title: Contribution

error.description: the last error of the question's scoring calls
error.title: Error

predicted_slope.description: predicted gain in accuracy with practice, in logits per log-attempt (training median about 0.24)
predicted_slope.title: Predicted Slope

percentile.description: share of the training questions with a lower prediction
percentile.title: Percentile

class.description: higher or lower than the training median
class.title: Class

calls_answered.description: scoring calls that returned a usable answer
calls_answered.title: Calls Answered

raising.description: features present that raised the prediction, largest first
raising.title: Raising

lowering.description: features present that lowered the prediction, largest first
lowering.title: Lowering

scores.description: the score on each checklist feature, 0 to 1
scores.title: Scores

model.description: the dataset the predictor was trained on
model.title: Model

scorer.description: the scorer named in the request
scorer.title: Scorer

served_by.description: answered calls by the model that served them, as OpenRouter reports it (a router forwards to other models)
served_by.title: Served By

cost.description: total cost in USD that OpenRouter reported for the calls
cost.title: Cost

predictions.description: one per question that was scored, in request order
predictions.title: Predictions

failed.description: questions with no usable scoring call
failed.title: Failed
